milestone.describes: A level is being played: the bee rolls where the device is tipped, the flowers and the spinner on the board react as it goes, and the board is still live after half a minute of steering.

steps.expect: The file-select screen: three slots down the left, each marked NEW on a fresh profile, with Select File To Load beside them.
The first level: a honeycomb board with flowers, a spinner, gates, and the bee at the left.
The board before any tilting, for comparison.
The bee has ended up somewhere it did not start, the board has changed as it went, and nothing has stopped.

notes: Coordinates are client coordinates for the 320x480 portrait window. A capture includes the window border and title bar, so a position read off a frame is about (8, 31) out.

This game is steered by tilting, and the route uses the `tilt` action for it: a tilt is the right mouse button held at a point, where the middle of the window is level. Without it the board comes up and nothing happens, which looks like a game that does not work.
The two other Dizzy Bee files in the collection - Dizzy Bee 2 and DizzyBeeFree - are separate apps with their own bundle identifiers and have not been checked against this route.
